result.title: Solar-Conditioned Flow Matching for Multitemporal Aerial Visible-to-Infrared Image Translation
result.comment: 5 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to IEEE GRSL
result.summary: Aerial visible-to-infrared (V2IR) image translation provides scalable thermal data across the full diurnal cycle. However, existing methods predominantly learn a static mapping within narrow acquisition windows. As the thermal state evolves throughout the day, a single visible image may correspond to multiple plausible IR appearances, making V2IR translation an inherently multitemporal task. This letter proposes solar-conditioned latent flow matching (Solar-Flow), which upgrades aerial V2IR translation from static mapping to multitemporal generation. First, we design three computable physical factors, namely the solar elevation, the thermal phase clock (TPC), and the flight altitude. The TPC counts the elapsed heating and cooling hours on a continuous 24-hour axis anchored at sunrise, so the thermal state stays well defined even at hours without training samples. Second, we inject the condition into every Transformer block of a pretrained flow matching generator through adaptive layer normalization. This design preserves translation fidelity and enables multitemporal generation. Finally, we construct a paired aerial V2IR dataset covering 14 hour groups. Solar-Flow achieves multitemporal generation on this dataset, where a single visible image is translated into plausible IR images at multiple times of day, even at hours that were never seen in training.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Solar-Flow，在航空可见光到红外图像翻译中用太阳高度、热相位时钟与飞行高度作为连续物理条件，经 adaLN 注入预训练 flow matching 生成器的每个 Transformer 块，实现单张可见光图像向一天多个时刻红外图像的多时相生成，并构建覆盖 14 个时段组的配对数据集。
AI.relevance_reason: 单张图像对应多个合理红外外观，本质是未观测物理状态导致的证据歧义，其用连续相位变量条件化并外推到未见时刻的做法，可能为 LVR 中多 latent 假设的表示与条件外推提供概念线索，但联系较远，需核查。
